name: code-maat
description: code-maat — codebase analysis CLI. Analyze git history for hotspots, churn, complexity trends.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/adamtornhill/code-maat/releases/latest/download/code-maat-1.0.4-standalone.jar && sudo mv code-maat-1.0.4-standalone.jar /usr/local/bin/code-maat.jar && echo 'java -jar /usr/local/bin/code-maat.jar' | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/code-maat && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/code-maat

commands.description: code-maat — codebase analysis CLI. Analyze git history for hotspots, churn, complexity trends.
